description: Grade colour pairs against WCAG 2.1 contrast, at the threshold the text size earns: 18pt, or 14pt bold, is large scale and needs 3:1 where body text needs 4.5:1. Takes pairs you name, so it grades colours you are about to ship rather than only colours already on a page. Returns the ratio, the required ratio, and the AA and AAA verdicts per pair. Pure and synchronous, no browser. For pairs already rendered on a site, extract with wcag instead.

background.description: Background it sits on, hex or rgb()

fontSizePx.description: Rendered size in px. Without it the pair is graded as body text

label.description: Your own name for the pair, echoed back

name: check_contrast
